text:
leo: starting micro-rollout for v3.3.0 — US micro-canary 3% to validate tokenizer fix and rerank stability. keeping strict regional quarantine for now.
deploy-bot: kickoff: region=us percent=3 model=redwood-v3.3.0 image=sha256:12ab34cd deploy_id=deploy-5309876543
tara-sre: quick capacity snapshot: pool-p4x has spare_nodes=6, pool-t4-spot spare_nodes=8. expected canary qps ~80. thermal margin ok for 45m.
amanda: note on spill protection: platform default allows cross-region overflow. we should set spillover=disabled for micro-canary to avoid accidental EU/APAC exposure.
infra-bot: config applied:
```
canary_policy:
  region_isolation: true
  spillover: disabled
  pinned_model: redwood-v3.3.0
```

leo: rollback heuristics (draft):
- sustained client_error_rate >= 1% for 4m
- p95 latency +150ms above baseline for 5m
- any generation schema mismatch detected by health-check
- bot-detected hallucation-rate increase > 1%

ops-oncall: add: if more than 2 pods restart within 10m in primary pool -> auto-hold and notify oncall. set pager if p95 > 300ms.
deploy-bot: automated progression: 3% -> 15% at +12m -> 40% at +30m (conditional). next auto-step at 5309876610.
tara-sre: running smoke on rerank route now: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.internal/rerank -d '{"items":["a","b"],"q":"test"}' | jq .`
tara-sre: smoke OK. scores within baseline variance, p95=108ms. no schema diffs.
leo: proceeding to 15% in 6m if telemetry OK. amanda, please update release note with a short note about tokenizer edge-case fix and mention no customer-visible API changes.
amanda: notes posted in #releases: "v3.3.0 — tokenizer edge-case fix; reranker stability improvements" https://go/releases/3.3.0

(deploy-bot progress)
deploy-bot: advanced to 15% at 5309876601
tara-sre: live metrics look stable. p95=115ms, errors=0.25%. no EU spill.
ops-oncall: observed a brief queue spike on t4 fallback at +7m, autoscaler added node, no client 5xx. logging trace available.
leo: good. hold at 15% for 20m. if all green plan EU canary next morning 04:00 UTC, APAC following day 09:00 UTC.
ops-oncall: scheduling note: if hold at 40% extends >1h, prewarm EU pool to 4 nodes and enable a soft-fallback window. infra-bot set rule?
infra-bot: prewarm rule created: hold_at_40m_gt_60m -> prewarm_eu_nodes=4

(End)
ops-oncall: US micro-canary stable. recommend same exact safety checks for EU/APAC; will open separate thread for EU kickoff tomorrow. closing this thread once EU starts. :white_check_mark:
